title: Riverside Substation Asset Register
body: Authoritative register of utility assets at Riverside 132/33 kV substation SUB-01. The substation contains two 132/33 kV power transformers TRF-0147 and TRF-0148 and two 33 kV feeder breakers BRK-2201 and BRK-2202. Transformer TRF-0147 oil dielectric strength 46 kV, bushings last tested 2026-05-14. Transformer TRF-0148 oil dielectric strength 42 kV, bushings last tested 2025-11-02. Both breakers in service with SF6 gas per spec_breaker_sf6_v1.
